transcripts.transcript:
Good morning, Helen Carter. This is Daniel Reed. We have our arranged portfolio call today. Are you somewhere comfortable to talk, or would you prefer a moment to get settled?

Good morning, Daniel. I'm comfortable here, with my paperwork beside me. I'll give you my details before we begin. My identification number is G four two five seven nine nine eight E. My date of birth is the eleventh of December nineteen fifty-three.

Thank you. Before we turn to the portfolio, how has the gardening been going? You mentioned that you were spending more time outside since retiring.

Very pleasantly, although the weeds seem to be enjoying retirement as much as I am. I've been clearing the borders and finding room for herbs near the kitchen. It is satisfying to have something practical to do without a business timetable.

That sounds like a welcome change of pace. For future appointments, does speaking by telephone still suit you better than coming into the branch?

Telephone appointments are much easier. I can have the paperwork laid out at home and avoid making a special journey. I would rather keep branch visits for anything that genuinely needs me there.

We can keep telephone appointments as your preference when arranging future reviews. For today, we can keep the conversation straightforward and leave the general commentary aside.

That suits me. I review the paperwork regularly, but I prefer a focused conversation rather than a long tour through everything in the portfolio. The holding I want to reduce is Meridian Asia Equity Fund.

I understand your objective is to reduce your exposure to Asian equity markets and free up money for personal spending. The value of Meridian Asia Equity Fund can fall sharply if Asian share prices decline because of regional economic weakness or political developments. Do you understand how those regional market developments could cause the value of your fund holding to fall sharply?

Yes, I understand that regional economic or political developments could cause Asian share prices to drop sharply and reduce the value of my holding.

The transaction charge for this sale is 0.3%. You could lose some or all of the capital invested in this fund, and selling may crystallise a loss. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including realising a loss on this sale, to reduce your exposure and meet your spending needs?

Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses and realise a loss on this sale to reduce my exposure and release money for spending.

I recommend reducing your holding in Meridian Asia Equity Fund because that would lower your exposure to Asian equity volatility while releasing money for your planned personal spending.

Please use euro as the transaction currency. The transaction amount I am specifying is 50,000. The quantity for the transaction is 700 units. I want to sell those units. Please place this as a market order.

Please confirm your final instruction: sell 700 units of Meridian Asia Equity Fund using a market order, with the transaction currency specified as euro and the stated transaction amount as 50,000. Is that your final instruction?

Yes, I confirm that is my final transaction instruction. Please place the order as stated.

Thank you, Helen. That concludes the discussion for today. When you arrange your next appointment, you can ask for a telephone call again.

Thank you, Daniel. This has fitted neatly into my morning. I'll get back to the garden now. Goodbye.

Enjoy the rest of your morning. Goodbye.
